title: ekl_capabilities output
description: Capability manifests (providers), the token endpoint and authorization settings.

execution_admission.description: Your execution-admission profile. Declare it to offer paid capabilities: a paid call is admitted only after you redeem its grant.

execution_dedup_window_seconds.description: How long you keep execution IDs for deduplication (reference: 604800, 7 days).

authorization.description: Your token endpoint's authorization profile and its bounds. Part of the private descriptor; consumers read it after connecting.

max_decision_age_ms.description: Longest time between your relationship_check decision and issuing a token; refuse issuance after it (reference: 5000).

access_token_max_age_seconds.description: Lifetime of the access tokens you issue (at most 900).

expiry_tolerance_seconds.description: Clock tolerance when you check a token's expiry (at most 60).

revocation_delivery_target_ms.description: How soon you apply a revocation from the feed, as a target (reference: 60000).

refresh_tokens.description: Always false in ekl-auth-1.1: no refresh tokens.

capabilities.summary: Extract invoice line items, totals and the supplier EIN from supplier invoices as JSON.
capabilities.input_summary: Plain text of one supplier invoice
capabilities.output_summary: Invoice number, supplier, EIN, line items and total
capabilities.limitations: Text invoices only; scanned images are not supported.
capabilities.data_policy: Invoice text is not retained after the response.

invoice_text.description: Plain text of one supplier invoice
